title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.pwaosago (npm)
description: The npm package statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.pwaosago contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
